evidence.quote: The efficacy of LISRAYA in the treatment of dermatomyositis in adults was assessed in a Phase 3 randomized, double-blind, multicenter, placebo-controlled trial in 241 adult patients with dermatomyositis (Trial DM; NCT05437263).
